name: code-modernization
description: Unofficial Codex SDK adaptation of Anthropic Code Modernization: discover, approve, migrate, verify and harden.

interface.shortDescription: Modernization workflows executed with the official Codex SDK.
interface.longDescription: Official Codex SDK workflows, deterministic source shards and rule catalogs, trusted Codex lifecycle hooks, a local browser panel, rule review, brief approval, proof reports and SDK/parent activity. Node.js 20+, pinned SDK, XML and WASM regex dependencies; no Python runtime or telemetry.
defaultPrompt: Use $modernize to understand this codebase and plan its modernization without changing the legacy source.
